description: 600 synthetic applicants with fixed randomized offers, observed uptake and earnings; two labeled simulation oracle columns.
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: applicant
columns.description: Synthetic applicant identifier; excluded from regression.

columns.name: offer
columns.description: Randomized offer: 1 offered, 0 not offered; exactly 300 in each group.

columns.name: baseline_score
columns.description: Pre-assignment assessment used as a precision control.

columns.name: participated
columns.description: Observed training receipt under recorded assignment.

columns.name: earnings
columns.unit: Hypothetical currency units per reporting period

columns.name: take_if_no_offer
columns.description: Simulation oracle only: potential uptake without an offer; not jointly observable with uptake under offer in real data.

columns.name: take_if_offer
columns.description: Simulation oracle only: potential uptake with an offer; never an estimated-model control.
